Title: Azure Monitor Logs—New experience for agents is now available

Body.Content:
The management and download page for Azure Monitor Logs agents has been updated and enhanced with a new menu item and an improved UI.

Virtual machines (VMs) and other compute resources require an agent to collect monitoring data to measure the performance and availability of their guest operating system and workloads.

New menu item for agents

The agents management page is now accessible through a new menu item in the Azure Monitor workspace main menu:

Improved and updated UI

Windows VMs and Linux VMs are now managed in corresponding tabs, offering a cleaner, more appealing user experience:

We appreciate your feedback. If you have questions or suggestions, please email us.
